title: Annotated Code of Maryland, Insurance Article, Title 27, Subtitle 3 - Unfair Claim Settlement Practices
verified_how: Fetched the section page for Article - Insurance, § 27-303: live text opening 'It is an unfair claim settlement practice and a violation of this subtitle for an insurer, nonprofit health service plan, or health maintenance organization to:' followed by ten enumerated prohibited practices, including misrepresenting policy provisions, arbitrary refusal to pay, failure to settle promptly and breach of good faith. Served with enactments=false; no as-at date printed.
notes: Subtitle 3 sits within Insurance Article Title 27 (Unfair Trade Practices and Other Prohibited Practices). The first-party bad-faith civil action is separately at Md. Code, Cts. & Jud. Proc. § 3-1701.
